mentions.name: Adjustable-tilt DIY home solar array
mentions.description: A DIY home solar array that started with five 450W panels on a steel frame, using interchangeable long and short rear legs that pivot on an M8 bolt to adjust each panel's tilt angle. It was later expanded with 550W panels so the twice-a-year leg switchover is no longer needed.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started with 5 panels (450W each) and a simple design of interchangeable long and short rear legs to adjust the angle of each panel. Base of leg sits in a bracket on a steel frame, and pivots on an M8 bolt.

evidence.value: I started with 5 panels (450W each) and a simple design of interchangeable long and short rear legs to adjust the angle of each panel. Base of leg sits in a bracket on a steel frame, and pivots on an M8 bolt.
